say:2:1341115001:1.text: Evening chrysanthemums, aromagrass, orange blossoms, and bellflower seeds...
say:2:1341115001:1.source_cn: 夕菊、异香草、橙花、响铃花的种子……

say:3:1341115002:1.text: Mr. Faramor, what are you counting?
say:3:1341115002:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔先生，你在清点什么啊？

say:4:1341115003:1.text: These are some plants I found in the field. They have excellent medicinal properties.
say:4:1341115003:1.source_cn: 漫漫女士，这是我在这片花海里找到的一些植物，它们的药用...

say:5:1341115004:1.text: Evening chrysanthemums can be used to make an ointment for wounds, orange blossoms can be used to make tea, and the scent from ground bellflower seeds can repel insects.
say:5:1341115004:1.source_cn: 夕菊能够调制一种外敷的伤药；橙花可以泡茶，味道甘甜又提...

say:6:1341115005:1.text: I had no idea they had so many uses! What does aromagrass do?
say:6:1341115005:1.source_cn: 原来这些花草还有这样的功效啊。对了，那异香草有什么作用呢？

say:9:1341115007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Many use it to make incense or sachets.
say:9:1341115007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Many use it to make incense or sachets.
say:9:1341115007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Many use it to make incense or sachets.

choice_prompt:10:1341115007.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Many use it to make incense or sachets.
choice_prompt:10:1341115007.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>说得不错，很多人会用它来制作熏香或者香袋。
choice_prompt:10:1341115007.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Many use it to make incense or sachets.
choice_prompt:10:1341115007.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Many use it to make incense or sachets.

say:11:1341115008:1.text: Hmm... you're right about that. The scent's a bit too overwhelming for me when it's fully released.
say:11:1341115008:1.source_cn: 我，嗯……我的确不用它来做熏香。对我而言，异香草的味道...

say:12:1341115009:1.text: But it has other uses. With three pieces of aromagrass, a handful of black beans, and a bit of oil, I can make a balm that leaves hair smooth and silky...
say:12:1341115009:1.source_cn: 但它另有功效。实际上，只要三颗异香草、一把黑夹豆再加少...

say:13:1341115010:1.text: So that's your haircare routine! No wonder your braids look so neat, and your hair feels so soft!
say:13:1341115010:1.source_cn: 呀，原来法拉莫尔先生是这样保养毛发的！怪不得你的发辫看...

say:14:1341115011:1.text: *Cough*... Managing my appearance is a form of respect toward others.
say:14:1341115011:1.source_cn: 咳……我认为，整洁的外表也是一种对他人的尊重。

say:15:1341115012:1.text: Word! I enjoy being around clean and tidy people like <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Mr. Faramor!
say:15:1341115012:1.source_cn: 嗯嗯，我赞同！我最喜欢清爽干净的人了，就像<style...
say:15:1341115012:1.male: Word! I enjoy being around clean and tidy people like <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Mr. Faramor!
say:15:1341115012:1.female: Word! I enjoy being around clean and tidy people like <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Mr. Faramor!

say:16:1341115013:1.text: May we have some of that balm? Chippy and I would like to use it on our fur too!
say:16:1341115013:1.source_cn: 可以分我们一点香膏吗？以后我和满满也想用它来保养毛发！

choice:10:0:1.text: What do you use it for?
choice:10:0:1.male: What do you use it for?
choice:10:0:1.female: What do you use it for?

choice:8:0:1.text: It can be used to make fragrances.
choice:8:0:1.male: It can be used to make fragrances.
choice:8:0:1.female: It can be used to make fragrances.

choice:8:1:2.text: You can tell from its name!
choice:8:1:2.male: You can tell from its name!
choice:8:1:2.female: You can tell from its name!
